name: Tvg_Color_Stop
brief: A data structure storing the information about the color and its relative position inside the gradient bounds.

members.name: offset
members.brief: The relative position of the color.

members.name: r
members.brief: The red color channel value in the range [0 ~ 255].

members.name: g
members.brief: The green color channel value in the range [0 ~ 255].

members.name: b
members.brief: The blue color channel value in the range [0 ~ 255].

members.name: a
members.brief: The alpha channel value in the range [0 ~ 255], where 0 is completely transparent and 255 is opaque.
